conventions.convention: The middle form is Q_M(x,y)=⟨x cup y,[M]⟩ on real degree-2k cohomology of a closed oriented 4k-manifold, with the inherited cohomology-first cap convention and geometric factor order. Empty manifolds have the zero form.

Signature is positive inertia minus negative inertia, geometrically defined only in dimensions 4k, including k=0. Orientation reversal negates it; assigning zero in other dimensions is an algebraic extension.
Q(x)=x/tanh x is a formal even rational series with coefficients 1, 1/3, −1/45 through degree four; no analytic convergence or branch is involved.

The total L-class lies in the product of rational cohomology groups of degrees 4j, with finite convolution in each component. Pontryagin variables p_i have weight 4i; L_1=p_1/3 and L_2=(7p_2−p_1²)/45.
An isotopy consists of parametrized embeddings; a regular homotopy consists of immersions. An ambient isotopy starts at the identity. The track retains the time coordinate.
Tubular-neighbourhood isotopy requires the same induced vertical-fibre map to the ambient normal quotient; fixing the zero section alone is insufficient.

Self-transversality is pairwise transversality off the source diagonal. D(f) counts unordered branch pairs, whereas Σ(f) is the collision image; triple images are permitted. For oriented even m, branch-pair signs are ordering independent.
A rank-k normal inverse includes an actual smooth isomorphism TM⊕ν≅ε^(m+k), not merely a stable equivalence. The immersion sufficiency statement requires k≥1.
Normal Stiefel–Whitney classes are computed over F₂; normal Pontryagin classes and their inverse identity are computed over Q. Rank k forces w_i=0 for i>k and p_i=0 for 2i>k.
The embedding-specific Euler and top normal Stiefel–Whitney vanishings require m≥1 and k≥1. Integral Euler vanishing additionally requires an oriented normal bundle.
Full AC is retained for duality and characteristic-class consumers; countable choice is the stated hypothesis for isotopy extension, transversality and Smale–Hirsch consumers.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC. For every closed oriented smooth manifold M of dimension 4k, k≥0, σ(M)=⟨L_k(TM),[M]⟩=L[M]. With signature extended by zero in other dimensions, signature and L-genus define the same unital Q-algebra homomorphism Ω_*^SO⊗Q→Q.

Assume countable choice. For compact boundaryless M and boundaryless N, an embedding isotopy constant near the ends extends to an ambient isotopy supported in any prescribed open neighbourhood of its image, stationary near the ends, satisfying H_t∘F_0=F_t. The item also states relative, boundary-stratum and general-isotopy forms.
Assume countable choice. For closed smooth M^m and k≥1, the existence of an immersion M→R^(m+k) is equivalent to the existence of a rank-k stable normal inverse.

Assume AC. For a smooth embedding of closed M^m into R^(m+k), m≥1 and k≥1, w_k(ν)=0; if ν is integrally oriented then e(ν)=0. Together with rank vanishing, all normal Stiefel–Whitney classes of index i≥k vanish.
Assume AC. For compact oriented W^(4k+1) with induced oriented boundary M, the image K of H^(2k)(W;R)→H^(2k)(M;R) satisfies K=K⊥ for Q_M and has half the dimension of the middle cohomology.

Assume AC. On the stated numerable-bundle and CW/CW-type base scope, L is well defined, natural, stable and multiplicative: L(E⊕F)=L(E)L(F). For an oriented rank-two bundle with Euler class e, L(E)=Q(e); for a complex line with c_1=t, L=Q(t).

Assume countable choice. For closed connected M^m, m≥3, immersed pairwise self-transversely in X^(2m), two genuine double points with the stated disjoint arcs, compatible opposite signs and null-homotopic Whitney circle can be removed by a regular homotopy, leaving other collision germs unchanged. For oriented even m and simply connected oriented X, I(f)=0 suffices for a regular homotopy to an embedding, including after separating initial triple images.

Assume countable choice. A pairwise self-transverse immersion of closed M^m into X^(2m), m≥1, admits an arbitrarily small regular homotopy to a self-transverse immersion without triple images, preserving its finite unordered branch pairs and their compatible signs.

Assume AC. For a self-transverse immersion of closed oriented M^(2s) into R^(4s), s≥1, without triple points, there is a transverse normal section nonzero at collision preimages such that every sufficiently small positive push-off satisfies I(f,f_t)=⟨e(ν_f),[M]⟩+2Σ ε(r).

Assume AC. For m≥1, w(TRP^m)=(1+a)^(m+1) and its normal inverse is Σ a^i over 0≤i≤m with i AND m=0. If d(m) is the largest such index, immersion codimension cannot be below d(m). For m=2^p, p≥1, d(m)=m−1. The tangent total class is 1 exactly when m+1 is a power of two.

concerns.concern: Statement clause 4 says 'Clause 1 remains true without the hypothesis that F be constant near the ends'. Clause 1 also requires H to be stationary near the ends. Read literally, this is false: translate a compact embedded circle with nonzero velocity near t=0; H_t∘F_0=F_t cannot hold with stationary H there. Proof 2.4 correctly says stationarity is claimed only when the given isotopy is stationary. The statement needs the same exception.

The Statement permits compact M with boundary, but L1 restates thm-isotopy-extension clause 4 as applying to every compact M. That supplier retains the boundaryless-source hypothesis of clause 1, and its Proof 1.3 explicitly says 'compact boundaryless M'. The velocity-extension lemmas contain the local boundary/corner construction needed to close this case, but this corollary neither derives that extension nor cites an applicable general source-boundary statement. The same widened use is inherited by ex-isotopic-submanifolds-have-isomorphic-normal-bundles-and-complements.

F4 says 'On every product of complex projective spaces, σ and L both take the value 1', then writes σ(P_J)=1=L[P_J]. The displayed P_J notation suggests the restricted even-complex-dimensional factors from F3, which the cited lemmas actually prove. The unrestricted prose is false: CP¹×CP¹≅S²×S² has signature and L-genus zero. Name the F3 products explicitly.

F6 states without a dimension qualification that an embedding into R^(2m) has e(ν_f)=0, citing cor-top-normal-stiefel-whitney-and-euler-classes-vanish-for-euclidean-embeddings. The latter requires m≥1 and positive codimension, whereas this proposition explicitly includes m=0 in Proof 2.1. A positively oriented point embedded in R⁰ has the standard rank-zero normal Euler class 1, not 0. The obstruction argument in Proof 2.2–3.1 uses m=2s≥2, so the false F6 restatement can be restricted to that range without affecting that argument.

seams_checked.note: The middle-form definition retains AC, closed oriented complementary submanifolds, cohomology-first cap conventions and geometric factor order from the opened cup-pairing theorem and convention remark.

The consumers preserve the projective tangent splitting and normalization, product fundamental-class/evaluation identities, boundary Pontryagin-number vanishing and the rational bordism basis of products of CP^(2j). The L-genus proof explicitly avoids using the separate monomial-number expansion more strongly.
The consumed regular-homotopy definition requires a smooth family with immersion at every time. Whitney disjunction retains this requirement while allowing intermediate branch tangencies.

The consumers retain chosen arcs and path-compatible labels, null-homotopy, compatible opposite signs, an actual clean disk and an admissible extendible framing. The local move acts on one sheet with the other fixed; the immersion-image adapter supplies avoidance of other branches.
The knotting remark uses precisely π₂(SO(3))=0, together with oriented clutching, to conclude that oriented rank-three normal bundles over S³ are trivial.

The reflected-sphere example uses the m=2,n=3 sphere-immersion classification and the opened standard/reflected formal-data lemma. It concludes regular homotopy, separately proving failure of embedding isotopy.

The Euler consumer preserves the compact boundaryless embedded self-intersection scope, tangent-first normal orientation and transverse-section signed zero count. Its even-m restriction removes the Euler-duality sign; the mod-two clause retains its orientation-free scope.

This is a declared page prerequisite, but the assigned page items contain no direct citation to an item homed on that supplier page. No stronger characteristic-number proposition is asserted through this edge.

The consumers retain the quotient normal bundle and noncanonical metric splitting, boundaryless closed source, positive codimension and countable choice. The rank-reduction proposition uses only surjectivity on path components, asserting existence without assigning a normal bundle or regular-homotopy class to the produced immersion.

Opened lem-boundary-middle-form-is-well-defined-and-glues and thm-milnor-lambda-invariant-is-well-defined-modulo-seven. They distinguish the locally defined filling signature from the closed signature, and apply 45σ(N)=7p₂[N]−p_(1,1)[N] only to the glued closed oriented eight-manifold N, retaining AC and evaluation of the cup square.
